units: <cite ref="Tosefta Ta'anit 3:2">Tosef. Taan. III</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Ta'anit 2:2">II</cite>), 2 <he>ולא … בת׳ וכ׳</he> not that they were allowed to indulge in delicacies, but they eat and drink as much as is required for the maintenance of &c.; Y. ib. I, 64ᶜ top. Tanḥ.

<cite ref="Exodus 17">Mishp. 17</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Jeremiah 3:19">Jer. III, 19</cite>) <he>מה … לתַפְנוּקֶיהָ של בתו וכ׳</he> as a father feels bound to provide for his daughter’s enjoyments, so I provided for you; a. e.
